title: Parlay rho register - every correlation the site prices with, measured
answers: R14: price every parlay with the measured rho and print the naive product beside it, instead of withholding the price
rule: a rho may be printed as MEASURED only if it is computed from official data in this repository by this script; a hand-set constant is never labelled measured. Values that do not clear their sample floor are printed with their n, their interval and the floor, and the naive independent product stays beside them.
finality_rule: engine/model_v2.is_verified_final - an unplayed fixture that prints 0-0 in the dated captures is not a game and is excluded, not inferred

cross_team_points.pairing: both teams over a team total in the same game: the two legs are the two teams' point totals, so the rho that prices them is rho(home points, away points)
cross_team_points.why_this_pairing: the only rho a both-teams-over parlay can be priced with from official box scores
cross_team_points.bootstrap: 2000 reps, clusters = official games, seed 20261116, 2.5/97.5 percentiles
cross_team_points.jackknife_note: leave-one-game-out spread over 196 drops; with fewer than about 20 clusters this, not the bootstrap CI, is the dispersion to read
cross_team_points.source: the verified-finals corpus of engine/model_v2.load_results() (official NBA.com scores, filtered by is_verified_final)

side_and_total.pairing: side + total same-game parlay: rho(home margin, game total)
side_and_total.why_this_pairing: the pairing the roll page and the SGP generator both price
side_and_total.bootstrap: 2000 reps, clusters = official games, seed 20261116, 2.5/97.5 percentiles
side_and_total.jackknife_note: leave-one-game-out spread over 196 drops; with fewer than about 20 clusters this, not the bootstrap CI, is the dispersion to read
side_and_total.source: the verified-finals corpus of engine/model_v2.load_results() (official NBA.com scores, filtered by is_verified_final)

home_points_total.pairing: home team over + game over: rho(home points, game total)
home_points_total.why_this_pairing: a same-game total pair that is not two independent teams
home_points_total.bootstrap: 2000 reps, clusters = official games, seed 20261116, 2.5/97.5 percentiles
home_points_total.jackknife_note: leave-one-game-out spread over 196 drops; with fewer than about 20 clusters this, not the bootstrap CI, is the dispersion to read
home_points_total.source: the verified-finals corpus of engine/model_v2.load_results() (official NBA.com scores, filtered by is_verified_final)

same_team_players.pairing: same_team_players: rho(one teammate's points, a teammate's points) within a team-game
same_team_players.why_this_pairing: what a same-game teammate pair (SGP) actually depends on
same_team_players.p_value_note: not computed at pair level: 672 player pairs from 6 independent game-days are not 672 independent observations

cluster_inference.method: delete-a-group jackknife over the leave-one-game-out estimates (the game is the independent unit; the individual player pair is not)
cluster_inference.verdict: |t| = 19.78 against t_0.975(df=5) = 2.571 -> nonzero at the 5% level; t_0.995(df=5) = 4.032 -> also nonzero at the 1% level
cluster_inference.caveat: read the t with the same suspicion the sample deserves: a leave-one-cluster-out jackknife is known to understate uncertainty when k is this small (6 games), because dropping one game removes only a sixth of the pairs and the rest of the day is still in the sample. The pairing of teammate legs is clearly positive on six game-days of box scores; its precision is not established until the corpus clears the floor. This is why the row is priced AND bounded, not priced alone.

same_team_players.bootstrap: 2000 reps, clusters = games (the only clustering the sample supports), seed 20261116
same_team_players.jackknife_note: leave-one-game-out spread over 6 drops. With six game-days in the repository the bootstrap percentile interval below is optimistic - the jackknife range is the honest dispersion, and it is what the pricing sensitivity is quoted against.
same_team_players.status: MEASURED - BELOW THE SAMPLE FLOOR: 6 game-days of official gamebooks in the repository against a floor of 30. The point estimate is published and used to price; the interval is printed beside it so the reader can see it does not exclude 0.
same_team_players.source: official team gamebook box scores, transcribed under data/official/gamebooks/ and parsed by scripts/capture_player_logs.py
